scope: Segment 103 field-level rules, serialization, applicability, WIC/eWIC element structure, and EBT program-data structure

rules.title: Segment 103 is a Data Section 3 companion segment usable in any Data Section 3 field slot
Segment 103 is required when the transaction flow needs EBT-specific data; the applicability matrix is fully enumerated in SEG103-R-024 and Segment103ApplicabilityValidator
Segment Type is 103
Segment Length is 3 or 4 digits; 4 digits is required for EBT-with-eWIC transactions
Segment 103 maximum length is 3,334 alphanumeric characters
Field order matches Section 12.4 (Segment Type, Segment Length, Clerk ID, Voucher ID, WIC Discount Amount, WIC Product Data, EBT Program Data)
Request serialization: every Segment 103 field is separated by a Field Separator, including empty fields
Response serialization: there is no Field Separator between Segment 103 fields
Clerk ID, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 10
Voucher ID, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 10
WIC Discount Amount uses the positional format Account Type(97) + Amount Type(52) + Currency Code + signed Amount
WIC Discount Amount maximum length is 40 bytes, composed of one or more 20-byte positional blocks
WIC Product Data is bounded to 3,001 bytes and begins with a 4-digit Total Length subelement with maximum value 2997
EBT Program Data is bounded to 267 bytes and begins with a 3-digit Total Length subelement with maximum value 264
EBT Program Data contains 1 to 6 Program Data subelements, each bounded to 44 bytes
EBT Program Data subelement TAG must be one of the documented values (50, IT for requests; 51, 52 for responses)
EBT Program Data subelement with TAG 50 requires ACCOUNT TYPE fixed value 98 (not required when TAG is IT)
Segment 103 appears exactly once per message
Segment 103 originates at the device
eWIC does not support Return transactions (absolute prohibition, not a code lookup)
eWIC operations use a recognized prompt-code set (3086, S086, E086, 0086, 8086) carried in the companion Segment 100 Prompt Code

EBT Program Data subelement full positional layout: TAG+LEN+ACCOUNT TYPE(98)+AMOUNT TYPE(=TAG)+CURRENCY CODE(840)+AMOUNT DESCRIPTOR(0/C/D)+DETAIL(12-digit amount) for TAG 50/51/52; TAG+LEN+ADDRESS(28)+ZIP(9) for TAG IT

WIC Product Data subelement catalog: EF (Earliest WIC Benefit Expiration Date, 8 bytes), EA (WIC Prescription Balance Information, up to 14 bytes), PS (WIC UPC Exception/Denial or Purchase Information, up to 47 bytes)

Segment 103 applicability matrix: REQUIRED for Food Stamp Electronic Voucher (Voucher ID) and eWIC Purchase Completion/Voucher Clear (WIC data); OPTIONAL for all other EBT/eWIC transaction types listed in Section 10.5.3; PROHIBITED for eWIC Return

provisionalItems.resolution: Applicability matrix derived from Sections 10.5.2, 10.5.3, 10.5.4.8, 10.5.5, and 10.5.6: REQUIRED for Food Stamp Electronic Voucher (Voucher Number 'must appear', Section 10.5.2.3) and eWIC Purchase Completion/Voucher Clear (WIC Discount Amount/WIC Product Data are the eWIC-specific Segment 103 fields, Section 10.5.5.6); OPTIONAL for all other listed EBT transaction types (Clerk ID is always an optional receipt/request field per Section 10.5.4.2; HIP program data is state-dependent per Section 10.5.6); PROHIBITED for eWIC Return (Section 10.5.5.1). Implemented in Segment103ApplicabilityValidator.

Full WIC Product Data (154) subelement catalog transcribed from Section 13.2 Element 154 descriptor tables: Total Length (n4, max 2997), EF Earliest WIC Benefit Expiration Date (8 bytes, CCYYMMDD), EA WIC Prescription Balance Information (up to 14 bytes, bitmap+category+subcategory+quantity), PS WIC UPC Exception/Denial Information (up to 47 bytes) and PS WIC UPC Purchase Information (up to 34 bytes) — the two PS variants share one 2-character identifier and are disambiguated only by an internal bit-map, which is out of scope for structural JSON validation and is documented as such in Segment103PayloadValidator. Implemented as SEG103-R-023.

Full EBT Program Data (164) TAG catalog and Appendix M layout confirmed from Section 13.2 Element 164 descriptor tables and both Appendix M worked examples (lines 34900-34990 of extracted_text.txt): TAG in {50, IT} for requests, {51, 52} for responses; structure TAG(2)+LEN(2)+ACCOUNT TYPE(2, fixed 98)+AMOUNT TYPE(2, equals TAG for 50/51/52)+CURRENCY CODE(3, fixed 840)+AMOUNT DESCRIPTOR(1, 0/C/D)+DETAIL(12-digit amount) for TAG 50/51/52, or TAG(2)+LEN(2)+ADDRESS(28)+ZIP(9) for TAG IT (ACCOUNT TYPE/AMOUNT TYPE/CURRENCY CODE/AMOUNT DESCRIPTOR are explicitly 'not required when TAG = IT'). Both Appendix M examples were decoded byte-for-byte to confirm this layout. Implemented as SEG103-R-022.

Section 10.5.5.1 states plainly: 'These specifications do not support Return transactions' for eWIC. This is an absolute prohibition, not a code lookup — no Appendix G transaction-type code is needed. Segment103WireFormatValidator.validateContext now raises a hard error (not a warning) whenever an eWIC Return is attempted.

Section 10.5.5.2 lists the eWIC Prompt Codes as a literal enumerated table (3086, S086, E086, 0086, 8086), each mapped 1:1 to a specific eWIC transaction type. Section 10.5.5.6's general remark that 'Prompt Code is constructed from Transaction Type Code and Card Type' describes the underlying composition mechanism but does not override the literal eWIC table, which is what Segment103WireFormatValidator enforces.

Appendix L (Valid Currency Codes, Element 20) was transcribed in full from extracted_text.txt lines 34456-34944 (Appendix L-1 through L-9) into AppendixLCurrencyCodes.java. Segment103PayloadValidator now validates the WIC Discount Amount Currency Code subfield against this table instead of accepting any 3-digit value.
